name: Elsa Ersteraufschlag
personality: She serves certainty at a speed the committee has not approved.
visual_intent: Tall teardrop blob, swept ink curl and subtle lashes, wide delighted white eyes and sharp asymmetrical two-upper-tooth grin; ivory headband and sage sailor-style tiny collar; holds short wooden racquet upright and one cream felt ball high in other hand
biography: She serves certainty at a speed the committee has not approved. She serves approved certainties across the residents' association and expects every return to count as disagreement. The wooden racquet has excellent manners and very little patience. A dissonant card has persuaded her to offer a second serve before issuing a judgement. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der erste Aufschlag gilt. Einwände dürfen zurückgespielt werden.

name: Gustav Grundlinie
personality: He remains at the baseline because all change should come to him.
visual_intent: Broad stubborn bell-shaped blob, bushy ink brow, closed flat sulky mouth; sage sweatband and small ivory knit collar; wooden racquet held low across one flank, strings clearly visible not covering body/face
biography: He remains at the baseline because all change should come to him. He holds the baseline of every courtyard debate and classifies movement as concession. His racquet is worn from defending positions nobody was attacking. One ambiguous card has made him wonder whether standing firm and standing alone are related faults. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Er bleibt seiner Linie treu. Der Rest des Platzes wurde informiert.

name: Nelly Netzgewinn
personality: She is excellent at doubles until somebody asks whose turn it is.
visual_intent: Compact square splat, fluttering side ink crest, lashed eyes glancing sideways and nervous toothless smile; tiny ivory visor and sage neckerchief; hugs a little folded three-square net in one hand, wooden racquet at side
biography: She is excellent at doubles until somebody asks whose turn it is. She plays doubles by checking whether her partner is comfortable, then apologises for checking. The folded net represents the association's comforting division into our side and theirs. She increasingly suspects that both sides would enjoy a drink together. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie deckt die Mitte. Wer dazugehört, bleibt offen.

name: Viktor Rückhand
personality: He returns criticism with interest and a pleasing amount of spin.
visual_intent: Lean reverse-comma blob, one high skeptical eyelid and crooked closed victorious smirk; sage narrow collar and ivory wristbands; wooden racquet held backhand across lower side with both short goo hands, not face
biography: He returns criticism with interest and a pleasing amount of spin. He returns every remark with the sort of spin that makes a simple apology travel sideways. The building rewards him for winning arguments rather than games. A dissonant card about letting a point go has proved infuriatingly hard to return. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Er gibt nichts zurück. Außer mit Wirkung.

name: Bodo Ballwechsel
personality: He believes every rally can be settled by keeping one more ball in reserve.
visual_intent: Round wobbly upright blob, exhausted raised eyebrows, tiny toothless panting mouth; sagging ivory headband and small sage collar; embraces vintage open cylindrical ball tin with three visible cream tennis balls
biography: He believes every rally can be settled by keeping one more ball in reserve. He keeps three spare balls because the association calls every interruption a personal failure. The tin is easier to manage than his supply of reassurance. He has begun offering a pause to exhausted neighbours before offering them another chance to perform. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Drei Bälle sind vorrätig. Die Ruhe wird nachgeliefert.

name: Sir Satzverlust
personality: He loses with such formality that victory feels insufficiently dressed.
visual_intent: Tall oval splat, deeply weary half-lidded eyes and magnificent asymmetrical downturned mouth; tiny ivory cable-knit cricket-style collar with sage edge, little moustache-shaped INK upper lip not hair; holds a broken wooden racquet with ONE clean sag in string bed, body whole
biography: He loses with such formality that victory feels insufficiently dressed. He treats every lost set as a defect in the etiquette of winning. The sagging racquet strings retain a posture of institutional dignity. A card describing defeat as company rather than disgrace has finally given him someone to sit beside afterwards. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Niederlage war unpassend gekleidet. Er hat Beschwerde eingelegt.
